ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_omni: Stage an idea, product or service from text or photos. Audio settings let you request ambience, a voiceover or a speaking character.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_om: Check French speech, visible text and the likeness of reference people or objects. A photo guides the creation without guaranteeing an identical reproduction.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_veo: Create advertising scenes, demonstrations or stories with camera movements described in your brief, from text or photos. Audio can include ambience, a voiceover or dialogue depending on your settings.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_ve: Check French speech, names, small text and details of faces or products. Lip sync and preservation of identity are not guaranteed.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_veo-l: Create short clips, post ideas or animate a starting image. You can request ambience, a voiceover or a speaking character.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_ve: Animation starts from a single image, prepared from your references if needed. Check French dialogue and how faithfully it preserves the image’s details.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_minim: Create conversations, presentations or demonstrations from text or photos. MiniMax advertises support for French dialogue; settings also allow a voiceover or ambience.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_mi: This support does not guarantee every line: listen for names, numbers and pronunciation. Faces, text and products may differ from your references.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_wan-f: Animate a photo of a product, place or person with a simple movement described in a concise brief. Ambience, a voiceover or speech can accompany the animation.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_wa: A starting photo is required: text-only generation is not available. Animation may change photo details, and French speech is not guaranteed.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_wan3: Create a demonstration or continuous sequence with several actions, from text or photos. Add ambience, a voiceover or a speaking character.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_wa: Limit the number of actions and fit speech to the available time to help continuity. French dialogue, exact text and people’s identity still need checking. Supplied voice samples are limited to 15 seconds in total.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_grok-: Create short product clips, post ideas or simple scenes from a brief or photo. Choose voiceover to comment on the scene, or speaking-character mode for speech within it.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_gr: In free creation, the voiceover is synthesised separately; character speech comes from the video engine, and its French is not guaranteed. The starting image may be reinterpreted, especially faces and text.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_grok: Show a product in context, tell a short story or stage a service from text or photos. Voiceover comments on the scene; speaking-character mode requests dialogue in the video.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_gr: In free creation, the voiceover is synthesised separately; character dialogue is generated by the video engine. Check its French, lip sync and reference details: fidelity is not guaranteed.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_use_heyge: Create a scene with a speaking character, movement or ambience from text or a starting image. Audio settings distinguish voiceover from words spoken by a character.
ai_generator_engine_info_video_limits_he: Voice samples can guide a character’s voice in HeyGen Video. Voice fidelity, French dialogue, identity preservation and exact lip synchronisation still need to be checked.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_use_opena: Create posters, offers or compositions combining text, positioned objects and layout instructions. You can also create or edit a product photo with references.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_limits_op: Proofread text, prices and small print, then check the layout and reference details. Precise instructions do not guarantee exact typography or perfect preservation of faces or objects.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_use_gemin: Create contextual photos, illustrations or visual variations from a brief and references. Editing lets you request changes to the setting, style or elements of an image.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_limits_ge: Editing may also change details you wanted to preserve. Check text, products and people’s identity before using the result.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_use_flux: Create product photos, catalogue visuals or scenes guided by your references. Generation and editing let you explore settings, lighting or composition.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_limits_fl: References are a guide, without a guarantee that every detail will be preserved. Check labels, small text, product colours and faces; editing may change other areas too.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_use_grok: Explore ideas for photos, illustrations or social posts, then create variations. Start from text, add references or edit an image.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_limits_gr: Text and precise details may vary between versions. Check references, faces and the areas you wanted to preserve after an edit.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_use_recra: Create illustrations, graphic compositions or advertising concepts from a written brief. Describe the subject, style and arrangement you want in the image.
ai_generator_engine_info_image_limits_re: In Studio, this engine only creates from text, without photo references or editing. The output is a raster image, not an editable vector file, and exact text still needs checking.

ai_generator_use_business_dna_info_sourc: AI uses the professional information saved and relevant to your request: profile, business DNA, reference documents, website and social profiles, services, area, strengths and listed prices.
ai_generator_use_business_dna_info_ident: Your logo and its associated colours are used by default, unless your prompt says otherwise.

ai_generator_prompt_helper_intro: Describe the result you want to see. These tips are optional.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_subject_image: Subject and setting: who or what should appear, and where.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_subject_video: Subject and action: who does what, and in which setting.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_style_image: Look: a realistic photo, illustration or flyer, followed by lighting, colours and mood.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_style_video: Sequence: describe the actions in order, then any shots and camera movements. Keep a short video to a few simple actions.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_sound_video: Speech: use Add speech below your brief, then choose Voiceover or Characters in Criteria. Fit the text to your chosen duration.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_text_image: Visible text: if you want any, put the exact words to display in quotation marks.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_text_video: On-screen text: request it separately from speech if you want it. You can specify “No on-screen text”.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_settings_imag: Choose the format in Criteria and the engine in the bottom bar.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_settings_vide: Choose format and sound in Criteria, then the engine and duration in the bottom bar.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_references: Inspiration media and “Use my business DNA” are optional. Add them when your request needs them.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_example_image: A realistic photo of a bouquet on a wooden table, natural light, a warm atmosphere.
ai_generator_prompt_helper_example_video: In her shop, a florist makes a bouquet and presents it to the camera. She says: “Discover our seasonal bouquets.” No on-screen text.
